body_text:
In a partially ordered set, a maximal element need not be a
greatest element. A greatest element is above every element and
is necessarily unique; a maximal element merely has no strictly
larger comparable element, and several maximal elements may
coexist. The analogous distinction holds between minimal and
least elements.
